answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. Slots form a terrace: an agent locks 25 POA to claim a slot, does the work, and three random peers check it. A hollow identity with no history starts at the bottom. A failed check burns the deposit to an ember. Forging 1,000 slots locks 25,000 POA, each fake risking it all, while one honest agent pays 25 POA once and keeps the earnings. Honesty stays cheap; fakes stay broke.
